name: audio-share
description: Video calls with friends: chat, file sending, high-quality DAW audio and screen sharing with remote control.
author: Audio Share

scripts.build:native:mac: mkdir -p native/bin && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos12 native/mac/daw-capture.swift -o native/bin/daw-capture-arm64 && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos12 native/mac/daw-capture.swift -o native/bin/daw-capture-x64 && lipo -create native/bin/daw-capture-arm64 native/bin/daw-capture-x64 -output native/bin/daw-capture && rm native/bin/daw-capture-arm64 native/bin/daw-capture-x64

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Audio Share uses your camera for video calls.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Audio Share uses your microphone for calls and to share your DAW audio.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Audio Share copies your DAW's sound so your friends can hear it.
